newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are expected to be lower on Wednesday on possible profit-taking as the market lacked fresh leads, brokers said.
Analysts and brokers said they believed that for the last seven days the index had performed better than expected, given the uncertainties surrounding the ongoing general election campaign.
"If you look at the index and rises of some blue chips in the last few days .. it's higher than predicted. There should be some correction today," an analyst with a Japanese brokerage firm said.
But she predicted the correction would be slim and gradual as market was confident there would be no sharp shocks ahead of the May 29 general elections.
Brokers said some medium and small-size counters such as Elang Realty, now known as Bakrie Land Development, and Bayu Buana could continue gaining on speculative interest.
Elang has been active for the last two weeks following news that it will propose a rights issue in the third or fourth quarter of this year.
Brokers said the news had prompted speculative buying on market talk of the composition and price of the issue.
Blue chip telecommunications firm Indosat was likely to attract some market attention as the company was scheduled to announce its first quarter results on Wednesday.
On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index fell 2.95 points, or 0.44 percent, to close at 672.87 points.
